about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: .NET Developer in training · C#, ASP.NET, REST APIs, SQL · Java & Web (HTML, CSS, JS) · Constant learning
about.p1: I'm a programming student at the National Technological University (UTN), with a strong interest in software development and technological innovation. I'm in constant training, looking to take my academic knowledge into real and challenging environments.
about.p2: I stand out for being a disciplined, focused person with great willpower. I enjoy learning new things and continuously improving, both technically and personally. I have a proactive attitude, energy to face challenges and the ability to stay focused until I achieve results.
about.p3: On a technical level, I have knowledge in C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and SQL, and experience in developing web and desktop applications, working with technologies such as ASP.NET, Entity Framework and ADO.NET. I've participated in projects like library management and vehicle rental systems, applying good practices and problem solving.
about.p4: I really value teamwork and a good work environment. I consider myself a collaborative, friendly and committed person, always willing to contribute and help others achieve goals together.
about.p5: Currently, I'm looking for opportunities that allow me to keep growing as a developer, gain professional experience and add value to real projects.
